dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Vascular parkinsonism (lower-body parkinsonism from strategic small-vessel cerebrovascular disease, despite normal-appearing MRI)

Alternatives:
1. Idiopathic Parkinson's disease, postural-instability/gait-difficulty (PIGD) variant
2. Normal pressure hydrocephalus
3. Progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP-parkinsonism variant)
